question: What active and recharge times do the vehicle abilities store (flares, smoke, active protection, emergency repair), and which own fields hold them?

sourceFacts.method: Every registry row Ability_*.ActiveTime and Ability_*.RechargeTime was read (20 abilities). For the 19 abilities whose file is saved, the ability object (Class_4918a771) was read for Field_143f8e7a and Field_bcfe8c70 and compared with the rows.

control.description: Field_143f8e7a equals the registry ActiveTime on 14 saved abilities and Field_bcfe8c70 equals RechargeTime on 14, which names the two fields.

eaComparisons: Smoke Screen cooldown 20 to 16 s: Ability_Vehicle_SmokeScreen.RechargeTime 16 (L3344)
Projectile Intercept System activation 0.55 s: Field_85c11a9b of the tank ability (L3343)

inference: Countermeasure flares on every aircraft: active 1.8 s, recharge 15 s. Emergency repair (car and helicopter rows): active 0.4 s, recharge 24 s by the registry.

Disputed pairs, where the registry default and the own value differ: Ability_APC_ExplosivesDetectionDetonationSystem active 0.4 (own 0.1), recharge 20; Ability_CV90_AdvancedThreatDetectionSystem active 10 (own 20), recharge 15 (own 20); Ability_CV90_ProximityDetectionSystem active 12 (own 20), recharge 20; Ability_Car_EmergencyDamageControl active 0.4, recharge 24 (own 30); Ability_Helicopter_EmergencyDamageControl active 0.4, recharge 24 (own 30); Ability_MBT_ActiveProtectionSystem active 5 (own 4), recharge 32; Ability_Vehicle_SmokeScreen active 8.1, recharge 16 (own 20); Ability_Vehicle_ThermalSmoke active 10 (own 7), recharge 16 (own 20). By the pattern of L3327 and L3339 the registry default is the one in use, which is not verified for abilities.
Thermal smoke's damage to infantry (EA 1.3.1.0: 'moderate damage to nearby enemy infantry who remain within the cloud') is stored as DamageInterval 0.5, DamageToDealPerSecond 12, InitialDamage 25.
Field_85c11a9b is 0.55 on the tank's active protection (EA's activation time) but 10 on the emergency repair ability, so it is not simply 'activation time'; it stays unnamed.
unresolved: Registry or own value for the disputed abilities. Test: time the tank's active protection window (5 s by registry, 4 s by own) and the emergency repair cooldown (24 s or 30 s).
EA's 1.3.3.0 'Emergency Countermeasures cooldown acceleration 1.5x' and 'Emergency Repair pause on damage 2 s' were not matched to a named row.
Thermal smoke damage: 25 at once then 12 per second in 0.5 s steps is a reading of three row names; test by standing in enemy thermal smoke for 4 s.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Vehicle ability active and recharge times: registry rows for 20 abilities, with the own fields named and the disputed pairs listed
leads.summary: The registry holds active and recharge times for 20 vehicle abilities: flares 1.8 s active and 15 s recharge on every aircraft, emergency repair 0.4 s and 24 s, smoke screen 8.1 s and 16 s, thermal smoke 10 s and 16 s, tank active protection 5 s and 32 s. The own fields are Field_143f8e7a (ActiveTime) and Field_bcfe8c70 (RechargeTime); 8 abilities store an own value that differs from the registry. Thermal smoke damage to infantry is stored as 25 initial and 12 per second. 119 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: A timed ability window or cooldown in game.
leads.statusNote: Registry defaults and own values read; which applies for disputed abilities unverified.
